label: Stationarity Suite
description: ADF + KPSS + PP + Hurst with synthesised conclusion. Runs the core battery of stationarity and long-memory tests and produces a unified verdict on whether the series is stationary, trend-stationary, or unit-root.

label: Pairs Trading Pipeline
description: Pair screening, cointegration testing, Kalman hedge ratio estimation, spread z-score generation, and half-life calculation. End-to-end pipeline that takes a universe of instruments and produces a trade-ready mean-reversion signal for the best cointegrated pair.

label: GARCH Diagnostic Suite
description: ARCH-LM pre-test, GARCH model fitting, standardised-residual ARCH-LM check, distribution diagnostics, and VaR backtesting. Validates the presence of conditional heteroskedasticity, fits a volatility model, and stress-tests the resulting Value-at-Risk estimates.

label: Strategy Validation Pipeline
description: Walk-forward optimisation, Probability of Backtest Overfitting, Deflated Sharpe Ratio, Monte Carlo permutation testing, and regime-conditional validation. A rigorous multi-stage pipeline that guards against overfitting and confirms strategy robustness across market regimes.

label: Fixed Income Suite
description: Nelson-Siegel yield curve fitting, duration and modified duration, convexity, carry and roll-down analysis, and PCA on yield changes. Provides a complete fixed-income analytics stack from curve construction through risk decomposition.
